_note: Industry, street, ownership, moat, critiques, gaps. Sources dated on or before 30-Sep-2026; later facts are in updates/later-facts.json.

animalFeed.point: Compound feed is a volume-and-cost business: maize and soymeal are most of the cost; feed makers pass on 60-70% of commodity moves with a lag (GAVL, Q1FY27).
High milk procurement prices push dairy farmers from home-mixed to branded compound feed (GAVL cattle-feed volume +18% in FY26, +24% in Q4FY26, +15% in Q1FY27).
Ethanol blending has made maize a fuel feedstock as well as a feed grain; GAVL flagged a 'huge price increase' in maize on the Q1FY27 call.

palmOil.point: India's crude palm oil output was 3.80 lakh t in 2024-25 (1.91 lakh t in 2014-15) against an NMEO-OP target of 11.20 lakh t by 2025-26 and 28 lakh t by 2029-30; oil palm area 6.20 lakh ha by Nov-2025.
Farmers are paid a state-notified monthly FFB price linked to CPO prices, so mill margins move with CPO; GAVL's Q1FY27 margin fell on a formula change.

On 24-Sep-2026 the government cut basic customs duty on crude palm and soybean oil from 10% to 5% (effective duty 16.5% to 11%) and on refined oils from 32.5% to 27.5%, to cool festive-season prices: domestic CPO prices, and GAVL's realisations, follow landed import costs.
CPO realisation for GAVL: ₹1,03,708/t (FY25), ₹1,12,781/t (FY26), ₹1,34,783/t (Q1FY27, +18%), lifted by the Middle East war (palm oil tracks crude through biodiesel, per the Chairman).

cropProtection.point: Domestic demand is monsoon-timed: June 2026 rainfall was ~35-40% below normal, delaying kharif sowing and herbicide use; the 2026 season ended at 87% of the long-period average (June 65%, July 101%, Aug 84%, Sep 92%).
Generic agrochemical prices bottomed in FY26 as Chinese competition stabilised; Astec sees CDMO demand recovering (Q4FY26 call).

dairy.point: Milk procurement prices rose for four quarters to Jun-2026 and were expected to stay high for 2-3 more; processors passed on ~70%.

poultry.point: Live-bird prices are volatile; branded frozen and processed chicken is small but growing fast through quick commerce, which solves the cold chain (GAVL, May-2026).

brokers.multiple: 10x FY28E EV/EBITDA (crop protection, palm oil, feed, less central costs); 11x Creamline, Godrej Foods, ACI (50%); Astec at market value less 20%
brokers.thesis: Near-term weakness, recovery underway; FY26-28E revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR 11%/16%/18%; FY27-28E EBITDA cut 3-4%

brokers.multiple: FY28E EV/EBITDA by segment (multiples not in the public summary)
brokers.thesis: Strong animal feed and foods support Q4FY26; crop protection and vegetable oil weaker (before Q1FY27)
Early double-digit revenue growth in FY27; recovery in crop care and Astec (before Q1FY27)

street.unknown: BP Equities published a Q1FY27 result update on 7-Aug-2026 (Trendlyne); its rating and target were not visible without a login.

consensus.note: No dated FY27-28 consensus published between the Q1FY27 results and 30-Sep-2026 was found; aggregator averages we saw were dated November 2026 and are not used.

street.split: Latest call per broker standing on 30-Sep-2026: three Buys (Motilal Oswal ₹675 after Q1FY27; ICICI Securities ₹900 and FundsIndia ₹683 from May-2026, before Q1). Targets have fallen from ₹940-980 a year earlier. No Sell or Hold found.

named.name: Godrej family trusts and members (Nadir/Adi Godrej branches, combined)

notes: Promoter holding fell from 74.02% (Sep-2024) to 67.56% (Dec-2024) because 6.48% held by the Jamshyd and Smita Godrej branch was reclassified as public after the 2024 Godrej family realignment; no shares were sold.
Godrej Industries raised its stake from 64.87% (Mar-2025) to 65.05%.
Temasek (V-Sciences) cut its stake from 4.49% (Sep-2024) to 2.43%; LIC from 2.39% to 1.21%; Nippon India raised to 2.09%.

moat.evidence: 16.5 lakh t of feed (FY26), volume +12% vs the market; commodity buying and R&D formulation let it beat industry growth and hold ₹2,000+ EBIT per tonne.
~80,000 ha of farmer plantations in allotted factory zones, best-in-class OER (18.8% in Q1FY27), 24 Samadhan farmer centres; zones are allotted by states and take 4-8 years to mature.

moat.dimension: Crop care brands and in-house molecules
moat.evidence: 30-45% EBIT margins on Hitweed (cotton herbicide) and Gracia; but concentrated in two crops, and new in-licensed products earn less.
Feed passes on only 60-70% of cost; palm-oil margins follow CPO prices and import duties; dairy passes on ~70% of milk costs.
Godrej Jersey and Yummiez are regional/early; dairy margins (2-5%) are half of listed peers'.
Losses in FY24-26 (₹47 cr, ₹135 cr, ₹81 cr); 47% of imports from China; CDMO pipeline unproven.
CRISIL A1+; adjusted gearing 0.81x after the Creamline buyout; group lowers funding cost.

critiques.argument: Two of six businesses (oil palm and feed) earned ~70% of FY26 segment EBITDA; oil palm's FY26-27 profits ride war-inflated CPO prices, and the 24-Sep-2026 duty cut works the other way.
Working-capital 'efficiency' is largely supplier financing (payables up ₹766 cr in FY26); it can reverse and its cost is hidden inside segment costs.

Capital allocation: ₹1,250 cr paid since FY25 for minority stakes in Creamline and Godrej Foods, businesses earning 3-6% EBITDA margins; ₹953 cr of it charged to equity as the price paid above book value.
Crop Care profit fell two years running (segment result ₹308 cr standalone in FY25, ₹224 cr in FY26, -38% in Q1FY27): new products dilute margins and weather risk is high.
The bull case: a new CEO is simplifying a sprawling portfolio, oil palm has a 'demographic dividend' as juvenile trees mature, and the stock trades below its own history.

gaps: Segment D&A is annual only; quarterly segment data are business-level figures from the presentations (EBIT for feed, oil palm, crop care; EBITDA for Astec, dairy, foods).
Standalone crop care D&A is not disclosed: our 'cc' line is the consolidated Crop Care segment less Astec (Screener), which nets sales between them.
Exact location, cost and capacity of the integrated palm complex and specialty-fats refinery are not disclosed.
No dated maize or soymeal price series to 30-Sep-2026 was collected; we rely on management commentary.
ICICI Securities' May-2026 segment multiples and BP Equities' Q1FY27 rating/target were not publicly visible.
ICRA rationale (28-Jul-2026) not readable without login; only CRISIL (A1+, 6-Jul-2026) used.
Monthly state FFB price notifications and the exact pricing formula change in Q1FY27 were not collected.
The share of feed volume sold in each region and market-share data are not disclosed.
Sunil Kataria's earlier career is not covered in the documents we used.
conflicts: Dairy EBITDA: segment result + D&A gives ₹56.5 cr for FY26; the presentation shows ₹53 cr excluding wage code and land gains. We use the segment-note basis for the model and the presentation for quarters.
Q1FY26 oil palm segment result: ₹86 cr in the Q1FY26 deck, ₹87 cr in the Q1FY27 deck (restated); we use ₹87 cr.
Astec EBITDA FY26: company ₹1 cr; Screener operating profit -₹4 cr. We use Screener for the model, the company figure in text.
